message.content:
I don’t know about screens or buttons—this isn’t my area. I just use whatever the platform gives us to check drone statuses, see if they’re charging, or get alerts when something’s wrong.

If you’re asking what I *need* to see, it’s mostly:
- Which drones are flying, which are charging, and which are broken.
- If a drone’s battery is low or if it’s stuck somewhere.
- When a job starts or finishes, so I know if it’s on time or delayed.
- If a charging pad is out of order, so I can fix it or move a drone to another pad.

But I don’t pick routes, assign drones, or do any of that planning stuff. That’s up to the companies themselves. Just keep it simple—no fancy dashboards or reports, just the basics so I can do my job.
